components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action for saving onboarding data or calculating freight.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0F766E; color: #F7FBF8; border: none; border-radius: 8px; min-height: 50px; padding: 0 16px; font: 800 15px system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-btn-primary:active { opacity: 0.88; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.72; }

components.description: Mobile bottom navigation with teal active state and compact labels.
